title: ToolGap: Hiding KV-Cache Restore Latency During LLM Agent Tool Execution
description: Experimental SGLang exact-prefix prefetch from file-backed L3 into resident host L2 during LLM agent tool execution. Two controlled single-NVIDIA-L4 evaluations use Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, one worker, full attention and TP1/PP1. The v0.1 synthetic-gap experiment includes 45 trials and observes 67–71% lower median continuation TTFT at 500–3000 ms gaps. The v0.2 real document-search tool loop includes 12 runs: L3-only median continuation TTFT is 511.96 versus 134.30 ms; tool-dispatch-to-first-token latency is 1158.86 versus 763.89 ms and excludes the initial tool-selection model turn. The GPU-resident negative control shows no meaningful TTFT improvement. Each condition has three repetitions. A separate fresh-main 29-test smoke checks compatibility, not performance. The report includes architecture, finite-I/O/cancellation ownership semantics, exact cache-state and publication-timing evidence, limitations, related work and reproduction. No universal speedup, statistical significance or production-readiness claim is made.
